numbers.name: spectral_positivity
numbers.value: rho(w, q) > 0 at 12 random decay and scattering points with w > 0

numbers.name: heat_direction
numbers.value: J = w rho [n(w,T_phi) - n(w,T)] has the sign of T_phi - T at 32 checks; zero at T_phi = T

numbers.name: entropy_production
numbers.value: J (1/T - 1/T_phi) > 0 off equilibrium, zero at equilibrium, quadratic in dT (ratio 4.0 for dT doubled)

numbers.name: burn_chain
numbers.value: coherent mode burns P = Gamma E (closed Caldeira-Leggett bath reproduces the rate within 8 percent); entropy rate P/T, bits rate P/(T ln 2)

note: Derivation and numerical check only; no external data. With the spectral function of phi derived from the parent action (C_L2_FROM_ACTION), the layer 2 statements d_iS >= 0, P = T dS/dt and bits = P/(T ln 2) follow for this channel: rho is positive for w > 0, heat flows from hot to cold, entropy production is nonnegative and second order near equilibrium. Nearest known theory: Kubo linear response, detailed balance, Landauer 1961. Not UET-distinct. The closed-bath check uses a friction scaled up five times from the action value to keep the run short; the law P = Gamma E does not depend on the size of Gamma.
